description.value: A new 54-site dry-camping ground on the west shore of Harrison Lake, reached by 15 km of forest service road; the lakeside setting and ample beach access are the draw, but there is no potable water and outhouses only.

address.value: Ten Mile Bay, Fraser Valley, BC V0M 1A0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Ten Mile Bay Campground is a new (spring 2026) dry-camping facility with 54 sites operated by West Harrison Reservations and Camping on the west shore of Harrison Lake, accessible via ~15km forest service road. The site explicitly states 'Not Available – electricity/power, sewer/sani-dump, potabl[e water]' and 'Dry camping only / very limited amenities,' confirming no power, no potable water, and ruling out device/e-bike charging. A full online reservation system is operational per the website's dedicated reservation subpages.
concerns: Access is via approximately 15 km of forest service road — may be challenging or unsuitable for loaded touring cyclists depending on road surface condition.
Potable water is explicitly unavailable; cyclists must carry sufficient water.
